title: Home-Site Lease Late Fees by Community: How the Fee Grows with Lateness
content:
How a Home-Site Lease late fee grows with lateness follows the community of the site and whether the period's charges are still uncovered on the posting date. The charges are **still uncovered** when the period's rent and occupant charges less credits still exceed the latest payment received on or after the due date (a latest payment received before the due date counting as nothing received).

| Community of the site | Charges still uncovered on the posting date | Late fee |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | yes | the percentage fee plus the daily late charge for each accrued day |
| Conestoga Meadows | yes | the percentage fee plus the daily late charge for each accrued day |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | yes | the floor alone, whatever the unpaid amount |
| Saguaro Vista | yes | the floor alone, whatever the unpaid amount |
| Willow Bend Estates | either | the percentage fee alone, charged once |
| Palmetto Shores | either | the percentage fee alone, charged once |
| any community | no (charges already covered by the latest payment) | the percentage fee alone, charged once |

Terms: the *percentage fee* is the late-fee percentage of the unpaid amount, rounded half up to the cent and raised to the floor; the *floor* is the amount that percentage fee is raised to.

**Hypothetical figures** — percentage fee 35.75, floor 35.00, daily late charge 3.00, four accrued days, charges still uncovered:

| Community | Late fee before any cap |
|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | 35.75 plus four days at 3.00: 47.75 |
| Bluebonnet Ridge or Saguaro Vista | 35.00 |
| Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores | 35.75 |

At Cedar Hollow with the period's charges of 715.00 already covered by a payment of 715.00 received after the due date, the fee is the percentage fee alone: 35.75.
